newsitem.title: UK: FTSE 100 opens firmer after Fed's rate decision.
newsitem.headline: FTSE 100 opens firmer after Fed's rate decision.

text.p: The FTSE 100 started the session stronger after the Federal Reserve's decision to leave U.S. interest rates unchanged, dealers said.

The index was 17.1 points up at 4,624.6 by 0744 GMT, having touched 4,625. The Dow reversed a 70-point loss seen at the London close to finish 74.58 points up at 7,303.46 following the rate news. Many expected a quarter-point rate rise

"People are saying Greenspan should have raised rates by the expected quarter point and that now he will have to raise them by half a point in July but that's so much hot air. He's the man calling the shots," said a dealer.
